name: Witch Doctor Voodoo Strings needs Puppeteer's Threads on the enemy when Bad Juju is used
contract: Voodoo Strings 705910: 'When Bad Juju is used on enemies affected by Puppeteer's Threads, it strikes an
additional time every 1 sec for 30% of the damage dealt over 3 sec' (G-1, read literally: the enemy
carries the Threads when the Juju is used). Puppeteer's Threads 92084 lays 572836 on the enemy after any
non-periodic damage of the doctor (AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:77-79, 132-141), and that proc runs
inside the hit (Spell.cpp:2969) before OnSpellHitResult (Spell.cpp:3057), where the Strings check reads
target->HasAura(Threads) (AscensionWitchDoctorAbilities.cpp:251-252). So a first Bad Juju on an enemy
without Threads threads it with its own hit and strikes 3 times (cycle 9 sweep 20261121-051237). The
fix reads the Threads at the Juju's launch (OnSpellCalculatedTarget, Spell.cpp:8667, called from
HandleLaunchPhase at the cast) and marks that Threads aura; the hit strikes only through a marked aura.
Two dummies 20 yd apart, beyond any 10 yd chain or splash; Dark Effigy is not known, so each spell has
one target. Fresh (5 yd): a real Bad Juju 802087 with no Threads on it: 0 strikes after the fix, 3
before. Threaded (25 yd): a real Malefic Wrath 807037 (2000 ms, Speed 35) leaves the Threads, then a
real Bad Juju (2500 ms, Speed 20): 3 strikes in both builds. 706898 ticks every 1000 ms for 3000 ms;
each count is read at least 850 ms after the last tick (hit 2750 ms after the cast at 5 yd, 3750 ms at
25 yd). Counts only, no roll. Puppeteer 92084 is passive and its learn applies it; 705910 is learned as
in the class entries, whose generated scenarios read its strikes (final07 runs 1 and 2: 3).
